bio.statement: I build mobile experiences that refuse to be ignored. Bridging the gap between {italic_start}obsessive design{italic_end} and {italic_start}rock-solid production Flutter code{italic_end}.
bio.paragraph1: As a mobile architect and UI engineer, I understand that aesthetics must serve function. Not only does an app need to look like it belongs in an Apple Design Award lineup, it must hold 120 FPS frame budgets on low-end silicon.
bio.paragraph2: Over the past 5+ years, I've partnered with venture-backed startups and established digital brands to ship production mobile products. Always obsessing over native platform nuances, zero-latency micro-interactions, and deterministic state pipelines.
